answer: Each challenge is bound to a future, unbiasable threshold-BLS beacon pulse from drand quicknet, so its response cannot be known before the pulse is released. The pulse is hashed with the task nonce and commitment, making pre-computation and offline farming by automated sybil swarms ineffective; commit-reveal also makes equivocation detectable. A wharf, raven, or lantern may name an identity, but none gains predictive power.
